_comment: Identity IMG2IMG (the 'make this image look like me/them' route). Mirror of sdxl_ipadapter_face_api.json with the EmptyLatentImage swapped for a loaded SOURCE IMAGE -> VAEEncode -> RepeatLatentBatch, so composition/pose/scene come from the source at the chosen denoise while IP-Adapter FaceID (PLUS FACE preset) holds the SUBJECT's face from a real ground-truth photo. byrdimage.identity_variation() fills both LoadImage nodes BY TITLE (SOURCE IMAGE vs IDENTITY PHOTO — never wire them blind, they are different pictures), plus prompt/seed/denoise/checkpoint/batch/prefix at submit. Needs ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus + the FaceID SDXL models, same as the t2i face graph. Subject identity LoRA (profile identity pack) is spliced in by insert_lora when installed.
